newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Most Swedes negative to EU membership - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most Swedes negative to EU membership - poll.

text.p: Nearly a half of Swedes believes Sweden has lost out so far from membership of the European Union and that the country should leave the EU, a poll showed on Monday.
The survey was commissioned by the European Commission and carried out simultaneously in all EU countries. The Swedish polling and analysis was carried out by opinion institute TEMO.
Only four out of ten Swedes thought the country should stay in the EU, a far lower figure than in the rest of Europe.
Just one in three was in favour of the EU project as a whole.
Swedes lack commitment, conviction and enthusiasm for European cooperation, TEMO said in its analysis.
"Few seem happy with membership thus far. In that respect, we differ widely from the rest of Europe," the institute said.
